name: excel-context-engine
description: Intelligent system that analyzes user requests in spreadsheet environments and generates optimal context for LLM processing

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:system: npm run test:all && npm run test:integration && npm run test:load
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate:system && npm run validate:deployment
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=backend && npm run lint:fix --workspace=frontend
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.prepare:deployment: npm run build && npm run test:system && npm run validate:deployment
